changes: LFOs and scenes on AMP ATK, HOLD and REL now shape the engine's envelope; before, only the knob and locks reached it.
An LFO on PTCH now sweeps the same range as on FLEX and STATIC tracks (it moved five times further). PTCH knob, locks and scenes are unchanged.
Scenes now reach VOIC and CHRD. VOIC, CHRD and RATO jump between scenes at the crossfader's midpoint instead of sweeping through the values in between.
Experimental release: emulator-measured, reported on one MKII; chip timing and complete memory bounds remain unmeasured.
